news.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
news.summary: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

news.title: CME’s bitcoin cash, uniswap futures, global PMIs: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 19.

news.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
news.summary: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

news.title: JPMorgan expands ‘JPM Coin’ deposit token to Ethereum for institutional clients
news.summary: The USD-denominated deposit token now supports peer-to-peer transfers within the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem, including Base.

news.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
news.summary: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

news.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
news.summary: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

news.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
news.summary: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
news.summary: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

news.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
news.summary: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

news.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
news.summary: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.

news.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
news.summary: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

news.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
news.summary: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

news.title: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
news.summary: World ID for Zoom is generally available after a beta that began in April, and is designed to spot deepfaked participants on Zoom calls.

news.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
news.summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

news.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
news.summary: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

news.title: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
news.summary: HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.

news.title: Crypto.com, Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts; Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood hold off
news.summary: Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Underdog, which also received cease-and-desist orders, have not filed suits in Missouri, according to court records.

news.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
news.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

news.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
news.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

news.title: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints tokens and moves $727,000 to Ethereum
news.summary: The attacker, after minting 10 million CYS, managed to bridge about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge and SWFT's Bridgers.

news.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
news.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

news.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
news.summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

news.title: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
news.summary: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US ‌elections and sporting events.

news.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
news.summary: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

news.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
news.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

news.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
news.summary: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

news.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
news.summary: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

news.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
news.summary: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

news.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
news.summary: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

news.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
news.summary: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

news.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
news.summary: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

news.title: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
news.summary: Applied Optoelectronics told the WSJ it objected because it was unsure how tokenization would affect its stock price, liquidity and volatility.

news.title: Turkey confirms Hex founder Richard Heart’s arrest, says police seized $7.15 million and six cold wallets
news.summary: Police reportedly seized $7.15 million in cash, six cold wallets, seven firearms and 1,400 rounds of ammunition in searches of 15 addresses.

news.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
news.summary: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

news.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
news.summary: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

news.title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
news.summary: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

news.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
news.summary: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

news.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
news.summary: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

news.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
news.summary: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

news.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro under development
news.summary: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.

news.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
news.summary: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.

news.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
news.summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

news.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
news.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

news.title: Strive’s bitcoin buying spree earns 27% price target hike from TD Cowen
news.summary: Strive plans fresh funding for bitcoin purchases as TD Cowen sees warrant-related stock pressure easing.

news.title: Crypto PACs escalate spending against Sherrod Brown in Ohio Senate race
news.summary: At least two industry-aligned PACs have poured more than $52 million into opposing Sherrod Brown’s return to the Senate.

news.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
news.summary: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.

news.title: Coinbase to power stablecoin-backed cards for Marqeta customers
news.summary: The expanded partnership builds on Marqeta’s work powering Coinbase’s U.S. debit card offering in 2020.

news.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading

news.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
news.summary: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

news.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
news.summary: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

news.title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
news.summary: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.

news.title: Strategy conditionally declares daily dividends as STRC hovers below $100
news.summary: Strategy conditionally declared daily dividends on STRC, which continued to hover below its $100 par value.

news.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
news.summary: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

news.title: Deutsche Bank prepares German crypto custody launch, eyes Asia: Report
news.summary: Germany’s largest bank reportedly plans to expand its digital asset custody services to Asian financial centers due to the growth of the digital asset economy.

news.title: OpenAI says research model spent another wallet’s testnet ETH without authorization on coding task
news.summary: OpenAI's research model used another wallet's testnet ETH without permission to complete a coding task in June.

news.title: Visa Direct moves USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global
news.summary: Visa Direct has brought USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global as its first commercial enabler.

news.title: Solana’s Liu says Shanghai event postponed over registration surge
news.summary: Solana Foundation President Lily Liu said registrations quadrupled overnight, exceeding the attendance limit registered with local authorities.

news.title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 16, 2026

news.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
news.summary: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.

news.title: Google demonstrates quantum computing breakthrough as observers weigh Q-day implications
news.summary: Google demonstrated "magic state cultivation," potentially helping address one of quantum computing's most significant bottlenecks.

news.title: Capital B posts wider H1 net loss of $78 million on bitcoin impairment charge
news.summary: The company attributed roughly €67.5 million ($75.9 million) of the loss to an additional bitcoin impairment charge.

news.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
news.summary: Bitcoin’s market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.

news.title: US federal judge denies joint Gemini-CFTC bid to undo $5 million settlement
news.summary: The court noted that Gemini voluntarily settled three weeks before trial and that policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment.

news.title: MSCI finalizes index rules that put Strategy, crypto treasury firms at risk of exclusion
news.summary: MSCI's new non-operating company rules could exclude Strategy, Metaplanet and SharpLink. The final list of affected firms is due Nov. 11.

news.title: Farcaster acquired by Balaji’s Network School, with new ‘social smart contract’ for users
news.summary: Balaji Srinivasan's Network School acquired Farcaster from Neynar. Users must sign a "social smart contract" or drop to read-only access.

news.title: CleanSpark and BitFuFu see bitcoin production slip in September as Canaan remains flat
news.summary: CleanSpark is ending monthly mining reports, while BitFuFu faces uncertainty over its Ethiopia deal.

news.title: Multiliquid, a settlement platform for tokenized assets, raises $8 million
news.summary: Multiliquid has raised $8 million across its pre-seed and seed rounds, with Polychain leading the seed round.

news.title: DeFi Development boosts CHAD dividend to 14% amid push to grow Solana holdings
news.summary: DeFi Development is raising the dividend rate on its CHAD preferred stock to 14% from 13% as it taps CHAD sales to grow its Solana treasury.
